Tags apex

Ranged Strikes ignore concealment and treat standard cover as lesser, greater as standard. Once per round, Recall Knowledge on a creature's weaknesses as a free action.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Ranged Strikes ignore concealment, treat standard cover as lesser and greater as standard' is the same real EphemeralEffect/cover-level mechanism confirmed on Gunfighter-Loadout (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/alchemist-goggles.json) but needs a linked companion Effect item to implement correctly, out of scope for a rules-only splice here. The once-per-round free Recall Knowledge on a creature's weaknesses is a limited-use granted action, not a passive modifier.
